reconfigure.title: Broadlink RM Max
reconfigure.description: Update the Broadlink RM Max connection.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address or hostname without a URL or port.
error.cannot_resolve: The hostname could not be resolved to an IPv4 address.
error.cannot_connect: No response received. Check the address and UDP port 80 access.
error.unsupported_device: The device did not identify as a supported RM Max (0xAF8B).
error.auth_failed: The device rejected local authentication or did not return a valid session. Check the Home Assistant log for diagnostic details. This does not necessarily mean the device is locked.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an incomplete or invalid protocol response.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one installation of Broadlink RM Max is allowed. Reconfigure the existing installation to set its address.
abort.already_configured: This RM Max is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: The address belongs to a different device. Enter the address of the originally configured RM Max.
